data: According to its Form 10-K for fiscal 2025, Amazon reported diluted earnings per share of $7.17 for fiscal 2025, up from $5.53 in fiscal 2024. That is an increase of about 29.7%. Net income for fiscal 2025 was $77,670 million (about $77.7 billion), compared with $59,248 million in fiscal 2024. Diluted EPS grew slightly less than net income, which rose about 31.1%, because the weighted-average diluted share count increased from 10,721 million to 10,827 million.
